summary: PLAT-103: validateApp now throws if owner is missing/empty (shared-contracts bumped to 2.0.0, breaking). Apps pass owner from package.json team: core-shell=platform, billing=payments, reports=insights. Merged in one PR (#1), CI and CD green. Assumptions: shared-contracts lives in-repo and is inlined at build time (no registry release or dependency update needed, so the three subtasks landed in one PR so main is never broken); owner values hardcoded to match package.json since the inliner can't import JSON; reports also calls validateApp so I updated it too (not deployed by CD).
